Pluto in your 10th House demands career clarity by the weekend. Saturday's full Moon in Scorpio hits your 7th House of love — an intense deep conversation you must have. Monday is your worst day with the Sun-Mars square in your 2nd House provoking reckless spending. Finalize a quiet money decision before Thursday's Saturn shift forces a karmic reassessment. Follow for daily Taurus updates.
